labels.shortDescription: Hours status changes only through approval
labels.value: The status of volunteer hours changes only when a coordinator approves, rejects or reopens them. New hours start as Submitted.
You need the Manage Volunteers permission to approve, reject or reopen volunteer hours. Ask your BarnCRM administrator.
Say why these hours are rejected, so the person who entered them knows what to fix.
Approved hours count in totals, so they cannot be deleted. Reopen them first (move them back to Submitted, which needs the Manage Volunteers permission), then delete them.

labels.shortDescription: A job with shifts or hours is kept
labels.value: This job has shifts or volunteer hours, so it cannot be deleted: its hours would lose their job. Clear Active instead to stop offering it.

labels.shortDescription: Second sign-up refused; {0} is the shift name
labels.value: This person is already signed up for {0}. Change the sign-up that is there instead of adding another.

labels.shortDescription: Attendance wrote no hours; {0} is the sign-up ID
labels.value: Sign-up {0} was marked Attended, but no hours were written: its shift has no end time, ends before it starts, or could not be read. Enter the hours by hand.

labels.shortDescription: Restoring would make a second entry for one sign-up
labels.value: These hours cannot be restored: another hours entry already records this sign-up's attendance.

labels.shortDescription: Letters need the Manage Volunteers permission
labels.value: Volunteer letters need the Manage Volunteers permission, which the Volunteers Coordinator and Volunteers Admin sets give.

labels.shortDescription: No usable letter template was chosen
labels.value: Choose a volunteer letter template. If none is offered, ask your admin to activate one on the Volunteer Letter Templates tab.

labels.shortDescription: The letter period is missing or reversed
labels.value: Choose a From date and a To date, with the From date on or before the To date.

labels.shortDescription: Skipped: no approved hours in the period
labels.value: No letter: this person has no approved volunteer hours in the period.

labels.shortDescription: Skipped: the account is not a person
labels.value: No letter: this account is a household or organization, not a person. Open the person instead.

labels.shortDescription: Skipped: the person cannot be read
labels.value: No letter: you cannot see this person.
